body.p: The independent claims are amended to overcome the rejection under 35 U.S.C. 101. Each independent claim is amended to recite sensors including one or more of a camera, a Global Positioning Systems, Lidar and radar. Next, each independent claim recites processing traffic object data to form geometric and kinematic data. Finally, each independent claim is amended to recite processing of the geometric and kinematic data to form a hazard measure. Support for each amendment is found in paragraph [0063] of the specification.

The independent claims recite a hardware system operative with specific types of sensors. Thus, a practical application is recited. Different data transformations are also recited. Consequently, the independent claims recite far more than an abstract concept. Accordingly, the rejection under 35 U.S.C. 101 should be withdrawn.

1.17, and 1.21 that may be required by this paper, and to credit any overpayment, to Deposit Account No. 50-1283 referencing Docket No. SYSM-001/02US 337597-2006.
